stories.title: Chilly Starts, Sunny Skies and a Slow Warm-Up Ahead
stories.summary: No rain is in the forecast this week! Instead, we're looking at a gradual warm-up, with upper 60s and low 70s returning by the end of the workweek.

stories.title: Father, son hit by car while walking to Huntersville school
stories.summary: Investigators say the two passengers were not using a crosswalk, and the car that hit them illegally used a turn lane to get around stopped traffic.

stories.title: CMS to host transportation hiring event this week
stories.summary: CMS operates nearly 1,200 vehicles that cover over 99,000 miles daily.

stories.title: York County inmate dies after suffering medical emergency
stories.summary: The inmate was found unconscious and not breathing on Saturday evening.

stories.title: Crash causes major delays on I-77 in southwest Charlotte
stories.summary: Multiple lanes of I-77 South were blocked by a multi-vehicle crash near Remount Road on Monday morning.

stories.title: FAA ground stop causes weekend-long flight delays at Charlotte-Douglas
stories.summary: Charlotte Douglas International warned passengers Friday night that even after the ground stop lifted, disruptions would continue into the weekend.

stories.title: 10 years without justice: Family of Charlotte teen killed in 2016 renews plea for answers
stories.summary: Zavier Ellis was just 15 years old when he was shot and killed in east Charlotte. A decade later, his family is calling for answers and an end to gun violence.

stories.title: Crash on I-77 North shuts down all lanes near Gilead Rd.
stories.summary: Lanes have since reopened after crews responded to an overturned vehicle just after Noon on Sunday.

stories.title: Chosen Leadership Academy gives Union County kids and families a “village”
stories.summary: The free program offers mentoring, sports and life skills, and leaders say the need for volunteers is growing.

stories.title: 12-year-old dies in Kannapolis house fire; another person remains in the hospital
stories.summary: The fire happened Saturday afternoon at a home on Polo Avenue. The child was pulled from the home and flown to a regional burn center but did not survive.

stories.title: Firefighters battle multiple structure fires in Morganton Saturday night
stories.summary: The fires are burning near Sundance Lane in the Chesterfield Community in Morganton. There are several fires in the adjacent woods as well.

stories.title: Man dies after dump truck plunges from bridge in Wilkes County, troopers say
stories.summary: The truck struck a guardrail and the end of a bridge before going over the edge and coming to rest on Dennyville Road, according to Highway Patrol.
